repository.name: Metabolomics Workbench / National Metabolomics Data Repository
repository.access_model: open; no login, registration, credential, or data-use agreement required for the selected public REST records

overlap.method: Exact, case-sensitive set intersection of unique nonblank refmet_name values returned by each study's /metabolites REST endpoint, followed by source-metabolite-name review and exclusion of isotope-labeled/internal-standard rows.
overlap.interpretation: The 145-name count excludes eight known labeled/internal-standard mappings and is the operational biological crosswalk count. Further annotation curation may reduce it. Overlap supports identifier-crosswalk and class-summary exercises; it does not make raw peak areas quantitatively comparable across studies.

selection_criteria_audit.important_qualification: The plain-text mwTab records contain the required study, factor, collection, analysis, MS, and metabolite-data blocks. The study-level JSON REST endpoints are valid. Three ST001521 analysis-level mwTab JSON serializations are malformed at pooled-QC factor rows, so the module must use the valid study-level REST JSON or plain mwTab text rather than those three JSON serializations.

independent_audit.result: Confirmed ST001521 plus ST003348 as the preferred pair, reproduced endpoint and design checks, corrected the overlap to 145 after eight labeled/internal-standard exclusions, and recommended ST000292 plus ST001789 as the stronger reserve pair.

sanitization_rules.immutable_source_policy: Files in module/data/raw are exact source snapshots and must not be edited in place. Sanitized/derived tables must retain source IDs and record these transformations.
ST001521_factors: Trim factor-field whitespace without changing repository labels.
Exclude QPP01 through QPP10 and rows whose Study_Diet, Sex, and Time factors are NA from biological analyses; retain them only as pooled-QC records.
Derive biological participant_id from the leading four digits of local_sample_id and verify observed visits rather than forcing a balanced panel.
Preserve Western as the factor label and document that the narrative calls this arm omnivore.
Use the valid split study REST endpoints; do not ingest malformed AN002533, AN002535, or AN002536 mwTab JSON.
ST003348_factors: Derive participant_id from the integer before the underscore in local_sample_id.
Validate suffixes 1, 2, 3, and 4 against rest, stat, rec3, and rec22, respectively.
Retain source sample_source=blood while setting harmonized specimen to serum from the collection block.
Treat the treatment-block value no treatment as a metadata defect; define the exercise contrast from the documented protocol, collection, and time factors.
cross_study_metabolites: Remove the eight explicit isotope-labeled/internal-standard mappings listed in primary_pair.overlap before constructing the biological RefMet crosswalk.
Keep analysis_id attached to duplicated RefMet names unless a documented within-study collapse rule is applied.
Never concatenate uncalibrated peak areas across the plasma and serum studies.

studies.title: Plasma metabolites of known identity profiled using hybrid nontargeted methods (part-III)
studies.population: Thirty adults aged approximately 20-60 years; 20 male and 10 female; ten participants per diet arm.
studies.design: FARMM longitudinal diet study. Twenty omnivores were randomized to inpatient Western/omnivore or exclusive enteral nutrition (Modulen) feeding; ten established vegans continued their usual diet as outpatients. Plasma was collected at baseline and days 5, 9, 12, and 15.

factors.qc_rule: Exclude local_sample_id values QPP01 through QPP10 and all rows whose Study_Diet, Sex, and Time factors are NA.
factors.subject_id_rule: For biological local_sample_id values such as 9002-3-PE, use the leading four digits as the participant identifier; preserve the repository factor fields as authoritative.

release.verification: Release metadata and all five study-level REST endpoints returned public content on the retrieval date.

mwtab_validation.json_issue: Malformed pooled-QC Factors object caused by the source text `Sex:NA| Time:NA`.

Malformed pooled-QC Factors object caused by the source text `Sex:NA| Time:NA`.

design_caveats: This is not a clean diet-only perturbation: antibiotics were administered on days 6-8 and polyethylene glycol bowel purge on day 7. Day 9 and later changes reflect diet plus microbiome depletion/reconstitution.
The narrative calls one arm omnivore while the factor table labels it Western; preserve both labels in provenance and make any mapping explicit.
The vegan arm was outpatient and already vegan, while the two other arms were inpatient controlled feeding. Setting and prior exposure differ by arm.
Ten pooled-plasma QC rows are mixed into the 160 factor rows and must be excluded from biological summaries and PCA.
Western male factors contain nine Day 5 rows and eleven Day 9 rows rather than ten each; do not silently force a balanced panel.
The four analyses use different chromatography and ion modes. Duplicate RefMet names across analyses require an explicit analysis-aware or collapse rule.
Raw peak-area scale cannot be compared directly with ST003348.

studies.title: An integrated LC-MS analysis of the biometric characteristics of different time cohorts of race walkers - untargeted
studies.population: Nineteen male student race-walking athletes with complete four-timepoint profiles; the repository notes that one of twenty enrolled athletes withdrew.
studies.design: Acute endurance race-walking study with fasting pre-exercise REST, immediate post-exercise STAT, 3-hour recovery REC3, and fasting 22-hour recovery REC22 serum samples.

factors.subject_id_rule: Derive the participant identifier from the integer before the underscore in local_sample_id; suffixes 1, 2, 3, and 4 correspond to rest, stat, rec3, and rec22 and are cross-checked against Collection_time.
factors.specimen_rule: The factors endpoint says sample_source=blood; use the collection metadata's more specific Blood (serum) designation.

release.verification: Release metadata and all five study-level REST endpoints returned public content on the retrieval date.

design_caveats: The study is restricted to male student-athletes; sex, training-status, and age generalizability is limited.
REST factors use the broad source label blood while the collection block specifies serum. Treat serum versus plasma as partially comparable, not identical.
The factors endpoint does not provide an explicit participant field; longitudinal pairing depends on a documented local_sample_id parsing rule.
The treatment block says no treatment despite the documented race-walking exercise protocol; use the study design, collection, and time-factor evidence instead.

REST returns 593 analyte-analysis records and 475 unique nonblank RefMet names, while the project narrative reports larger totals across untargeted and targeted work. Use endpoint-derived counts for the notebook.
REST and STAT were collected on the same morning, REC3 later that day, and REC22 fasting the next morning. Time-of-day and fasting status are part of the contrast.
Raw peak-area scale cannot be compared directly with ST001521.

cross_study_caveats: The biospecimens differ: ST001521 is plasma and ST003348 is serum.
The populations differ strongly in sex distribution, age, training status, and setting.
The interventions differ in timescale and meaning: a 15-day diet/microbiome-depletion trajectory versus an acute exercise and recovery trajectory.
Chromatography, instrument implementations, ion modes, extraction, and peak-area units differ. Do not concatenate raw abundances across studies or run a single cross-study PCA on uncalibrated values.
Use RefMet overlap for nomenclature and within-study normalized summaries. Any cross-study biological interpretation must remain qualitative and explicitly provenance-aware.
A RefMet match is not proof that two analysis records have the same isomeric resolution, annotation confidence, or quantitation behavior.

diet_study.title: LC-MS Based Approaches to Investigate Metabolomic Differences in the Plasma of Young Women after Drinking Cranberry Juice or Apple Juice
diet_study.specimen: Plasma (title and study narrative; collection field uses generic Blood)
diet_study.population: Seventeen young women completed the crossover and contributed baseline, apple-juice, and cranberry-juice samples; eighteen were recruited and one withdrew.
diet_study.design: Randomized cranberry-juice versus apple-juice crossover after procyanidin avoidance, with a two-week washout; 51 processed sample rows, 17 per condition.
diet_study.analysis_type: Reversed-phase LC-MS, Q Exactive Orbitrap, positive and negative ESI
diet_study.companion_urine_note: ST000291 is the paired urine arm and has 15 complete participants; use ST000292 for the plasma-plasma fallback comparison.
caveats: This is a controlled beverage crossover, not a full controlled-feeding intervention.
The collection field says Blood while the title and narrative specify plasma.
The repository Total Subjects value of 51 reflects sample rows, not unique participants.

exercise_study.title: Acute metabolomic changes of plasma in response to endurance exercise
exercise_study.design: Nineteen young adults sampled before, immediately after, and 60 minutes after a monitored 90-minute endurance run; 57 processed sample rows.
exercise_study.analysis_type: Targeted HILIC and reversed-phase LC-MS/MS on an ABI Sciex 5500 QTrap
exercise_study.caveat: Participants consumed a banana after the run; recovery samples therefore combine exercise recovery and post-exercise feeding.

overlap.method: Same exact unique nonblank RefMet intersection as the primary pair, with a documented source-name standard screen.
overlap.interpretation: 121 is an upper bound pending a full source-name curation of both reserve studies.

fallback_pair.verification: Summary, factors, analysis, metabolites, data, and mwTab text/JSON endpoints were retrieved successfully for both fallback studies.

refmet_cache.purpose: Authoritative offline source for RefMet standardized names and chemical class fields used by metabolite-class summaries.
refmet_cache.license_note: The endpoint does not state a separate license in its payload; Metabolomics Workbench terms of use and citation guidance apply.
refmet_cache.packaging_note: The full source is retained for provenance. A study-only derived subset may be generated for learner delivery, but it must record this source checksum.

cache_policy.scope: Primary-pair study-level REST JSON plus the authoritative RefMet classification JSON needed for offline notebook fallback is cached. Raw vendor files, duplicated analysis-level mwTab files, and fallback-pair matrices are not redistributed.
cache_policy.refresh_rule: On refresh, retrieve the same endpoints, record a new UTC timestamp, recompute every checksum, rerun JSON validation and overlap counts, and review release/license metadata before replacing this manifest.
